name: Mars Orbiter Mission
about: Mars Orbiter Mission (2013-060A, ISRO), launched 2013 Nov  5. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.981 au and aphelion 1.442 au against GCAT's 0.977 and 1.445
